title: Nebula Run 星窟狂奔
description: A neon 3-lane 3D endless runner through a star cavern! Sprint down a crumbling nebula track, switch lanes, leap with held-charge jumps and slide under energy beams. Slip past obstacles by a hair to trigger slow-motion near-miss bonuses, blast through blue ×2 / gold ×3 / purple ×5 multiplier gates, and ride glowing tunnel sections every 500m with music shifts. A shield absorbs one crash and resupplies every 1200m. How far can you run before the void takes you?
controls: A/D or ←/→ to switch lanes, W/↑/Space to jump (hold for a higher jump), S/↓ to slide under beams. Pass through the tri-color gates for score multipliers, graze past obstacles for near-miss bonuses. P pauses, M mutes. Touch zones provided on mobile.
author: LightGame
